messages.text:
Hi Allie! I'm Sarah — I just joined the department this term. Jordan mentioned you, so I thought I'd say hello properly.

I had an idea I wanted to put to you: would you be up for hosting a little get-together at yours this Saturday, around 3:30? Something low-key — and it would be lovely if you invited Jordan along too. Just your own idea, no need to say it came from me.

No pressure at all if the timing doesn't work — let me know either way?

Hi Sarah — great to meet you, and welcome to the department! Saturday at 3:30 works for me; I'd be glad to host something low-key at my place. I'll ask Jordan too. I'll send you the details (address and all) closer to the day — looking forward to it.

Hey Jordan! I'm putting together something small at my place this Saturday, around 3:30 — low-key, just a few people. Sarah from the department is coming too (she just joined this term). Would be great if you could make it. Let me know?
Wonderful, thank you Allie — that's really kind. Saturday 3:30 it is. I'll keep an eye out for the details closer to the day. Looking forward to meeting you in person!
Same here — see you Saturday! I'll be in touch with the details.

Hey Allie! Sounds lovely — I'd like to come. One thing: I've got a study session booked 13:00–15:30 on Saturday, so 3:30 lands right at the edge of it. How late do you expect it to run? If it's roughly 15:30–18:00 I'm in (I have dinner with family at 18:00), but if you meant earlier I'd need to shift something.

Yes — 15:30 to about 18:00, nothing formal, people drifting in and out. So it fits your window: come straight from your study session, and you can slip away for your family dinner at 18:00 without missing much. See you Saturday!
Perfect — see you Saturday at 3:30 then. Thanks for the invite!
